round: R0 - deep open-data feasibility and grounding for cross-context AGGREGATE response prediction
lineage: follows SP-007 (DOC-2-033) negative result: discrete supported-edge transport failed across cell lines; this project targets a different estimand - predicting aggregate perturbation-response vectors across contexts. R1/R2 score thresholds are NOT reused as if they passed.
operational_user: perturbation-biology or drug-discovery scientist prioritizing which perturbation-response measurements to make in a new cellular context
output_contract: predictive performance estimates with uncertainty for aggregate response transfer; evidence-ranked candidates for measurement; never causal claims, never treatment advice

estimand_frozen.unit: perturbation target x context; response = aggregate pseudobulk log2 differential-expression vector vs matched non-targeting controls over shared measured genes
estimand_frozen.task_primary: predict the response vector of a HELD-OUT perturbation target (unseen in every context) in each context, from other targets' responses across contexts
estimand_frozen.task_secondary: predict the response vector of a known target in a HELD-OUT context
metrics: per-target Pearson correlation between predicted and observed response vector
estimand_frozen.splits: by held-out target (primary), by held-out context (secondary); never random cells; leakage assertions mandatory
baselines: context-mean response (mean over training targets within context)
cross-context mean response (mean over source contexts for the target, where available)
estimand_frozen.method_requirement: >=1 mature transfer method beyond linear baselines, chosen and pinned in R1 under the environment ledger; compute ceilings documented as preserved failures

feasibility_gates.G1_contexts: >=2 contexts (cell lines or condition axes) with openly licensed, checksum-verified perturbation data sharing >=50 perturbation targets AND matched non-targeting controls
feasibility_gates.G2_third_axis: >=1 additional independent context pair or condition axis reachable with license+checksums, else recorded as absent (does not block)
feasibility_gates.G3_estimand_lock: estimand, splits, metrics, baselines, nulls frozen in this protocol before any outcome inspection
feasibility_gates.G4_environment: baseline stack pinned; heavyweight transfer frameworks probed with ceilings documented

r0_verdict_rule: GO to R1 locked benchmark iff G1 AND G3 AND G4 pass; otherwise STOP at feasibility with audit preserved
abstentions: cell-state claims abstained unless a supported design is preregistered
no reuse of SP-007 tau/support thresholds
